about: The fleet's one identity protocol. Every module verifies callers through passport, so editing THIS file (or src/schemes.py) changes the whole system on the next request — no module restarts. Read live by the server and by every client fallback (mtime-checked).

canonical_token.shape: base64url(JSON {data, time, key, signature}), '=' padding stripped
canonical_token.data: a STRING scope, e.g. "agent" — build's Rust verifier rebuilds the message with data as a string
canonical_token.time: WHOLE unix seconds as a string — build parses i64
canonical_token.signature: EIP-191 personal_sign over JSON.stringify({data, time}) — compact, that key order

mod.about: wallet/key-signed mod-protocol token (canonical shape, plus the legacy dict-data / float-time variant)

build.about: build console session bearer address:ts[:ho]:hmac — only build holds the HMAC secret, so build is asked
